narrative.details: You seek out the Flight? Present to me proof of your worth, mortal.
narrative.objectives:
Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.

You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.
